# mockingbird_event_settings (Resource)

A mock's event settings: which configured broker its event channels use. Destroying it returns to automatic broker selection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mockingbird_event_settings" "orders_events" {
  mock   = mockingbird_mock.orders_events.name
  broker = "kafka" # a broker named in the server's mockingbird.yaml
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mock` (String) Name of the mock.

### Optional

- `broker` (String) Name of a broker in the server's configuration (see `GET /api/v1/brokers`). Unset picks one automatically.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace of the resource. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, `<workspace>/<mock>`; also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Event settings are imported as <workspace>/<mock>.
terraform import mockingbird_event_settings.orders_events default/orders-events
```
